description: Source shell script establishing a series of test cases for a Git replay feature; includes setup, various test scenarios, edge cases, and configuration verifications.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message, used for setting up test repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, runs a shell command or sequence of commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail, verifies failure.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in output matches expectation.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to output for comparison.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output, verifies presence.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies configuration options for the testing environment.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests complete.
